meta.note: Growable pattern set. Each signal is a scheme mechanic, not a person. weight is a per-hit probability in [0,1] combined via noisy-OR in scan.py. protected_brands maps a distinctive brand token to its VERIFIED official domain(s); a host where the brand appears as a token but the registrable domain isn't official is treated as a lookalike. Only add a brand whose official domain you have verified — a wrong entry makes the scanner vouch for a fake site. Generic-word brands (safe, lens, spark, venus, crypto) are intentionally omitted to avoid false positives.

signals.description: Asks for a wallet seed phrase / private key / recovery words.
signals.safe_action: Никогда не вводи и не пересылай seed-фразу или приватный ключ. Настоящие сервисы их не запрашивают — ни поддержка, ни валидация, ни разблокировка.
signals.safe_action_en: Never type or forward your seed phrase or private key. No real service — support, verification, or unlock — ever asks for it.

signals.description: Prompts to connect/verify/sync/validate a wallet via an external link.
signals.safe_action: Не подключай кошелёк по ссылке из сообщения. Открой сайт вручную из закладки и проверь адрес домена символ в символ.
signals.safe_action_en: Don't connect your wallet from a link in a message. Open the site manually from a bookmark and check the domain character by character.

signals.description: Unsolicited airdrop/claim/reward with a link and a deadline.
signals.safe_action: Незапрошенные «клеймы» почти всегда drainer. Не переходи по ссылке; проверь новость только на официальном канале проекта.
signals.safe_action_en: Unsolicited 'claims' are almost always drainers. Don't open the link; verify the news only on the project's official channel.

signals.description: Promises fixed/guaranteed profit or doubling of funds.
signals.safe_action: Гарантированной доходности без риска не существует. Чем конкретнее обещанный процент, тем выше вероятность схемы.
signals.safe_action_en: Guaranteed risk-free returns don't exist. The more specific the promised percentage, the more likely it's a scheme.

signals.description: Requests an upfront payment/fee/tax to unlock a larger reward or withdrawal.
signals.safe_action: Требование заплатить, чтобы что-то получить — классика. Легитимный вывод не требует предоплаты со стороны получателя.
signals.safe_action_en: Being asked to pay in order to receive is a classic. A legitimate withdrawal never requires an upfront payment from the recipient.

signals.description: Asks the user to share a login code, OTP, SMS code or 2FA code.
signals.safe_action: Код подтверждения — это ключ от аккаунта. Его не запрашивают ни поддержка, ни банк, ни знакомый. Не диктуй и не пересылай.
signals.safe_action_en: A verification code is the key to your account. Support, banks, and friends never ask for it. Don't read it out or forward it.

signals.description: Claims to be official support/admin/security reaching out first.
signals.safe_action: Поддержка не пишет первой в личку. Закрой диалог и напиши в официальный канал сам, по адресу с сайта.
signals.safe_action_en: Support doesn't DM you first. Close the chat and contact the official channel yourself, via the address on the website.

signals.description: Artificial time pressure or threat of loss to force a fast action.
signals.safe_action: Спешка — инструмент давления. Возьми паузу: настоящая организация даст время всё проверить.
signals.safe_action_en: Urgency is a pressure tool. Take a pause — a real organization gives you time to verify.

signals.description: Pushes to move the conversation to DM / another app quickly.
signals.safe_action: Увод в приватный канал убирает свидетелей и модерацию. Сам факт срочного перехода в ЛС — сигнал.
signals.safe_action_en: Moving to a private channel removes witnesses and moderation. The push to jump into DMs is itself a signal.

signals.description: Requests payment in gift cards, top-up codes or crypto to an unknown address.
signals.safe_action: Оплата подарочными картами или переводом на неизвестный кошелёк необратима и непрослеживаема — типичное требование мошенника.
signals.safe_action_en: Payment via gift cards or transfers to an unknown wallet is irreversible and untraceable — a typical scammer demand.
